comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: For real? Thanks! I had this visual idea and then I was just going to make the text kind of abstract and expressive – I hoped for it to be like a little comic-poem but wasn’t sure it came out as anything worth while and almost didn’t post it. Your comics have been kicking ass, by the way. How did I not have a link to them before? Mistake corrected: everyone check out Spina Doodles, a comic that gives me wood.

comments.author: Matteus
comments.html: Beautiful comic. Props for making something so abstract.

comments.author: NotSoSilent Mass
comments.html:
I’m not sure if I can say that I’m glad that you did post this… but you should have absolutely no doubt that it was worth while.
There isn’t anything I can actually point to that makes it stand out the way it does, but where countless others have simply passed on by after leaving behind a laugh or bit of food for thought, this managed to reach out and spear it’s scribbly hand straight into my chest to give a sharp twist.
I don’t have the words to truly express just how deeply this struck, but it should give some perspective to know that I am (or was previously, I guess) one of the silent masses. I watch, I listen, and I read. I enjoy, I laugh, I occasionally have my thoughts provoked, or I get bored and I click “next”. But write a review, post on a forum, or leave a comment? Never… at least I thought.
So while I’m unsure if I can say I’m glad, as that’s not really an appropriate emotion for this work of yours, I can truly say: Thank you.
